name: Kintsugi Seam
job: Show a break in the work visibly, with what broke, how it was found, the repair and the guard that stops it recurring, joined to the next seam by a gold line.

anatomy.role: A 1px gold rule between seams: the repaired break (ROM primitive 6, Kintsugi)
Seam id and when it was found, mono, sentence case, gold
A `dl`: Break, Found, Repair, Guard; the term in a 6rem column from a 30rem container

states.name: Repaired
states.note: Two seams, joined by the gold line.

states.name: Phone width
states.note: Below 30rem each term sits above its text.

use_when: The work broke and was repaired, and the reader should see the break, not a silent patch.
A doubt was raised and withdrawn: the withdrawal is a seam too.
avoid_when: Do not hide a break in prose; every break gets all four rows, with Repair saying Not applied when it was not.
Gold here is the repair seam, a limit that was hit; do not use the seam gold for decoration.

data.note: `repair` names what was done or says Not applied.

access: Each seam is a definition list, so a screen reader pairs Break, Found, Repair and Guard with their text.
The gold line is decoration over a structure that already separates the seams.
